agents.name: MigraSutra Prime
agents.inputs: source scope; user-approved target; risk tolerance; scanned artifacts
agents.outputs: versioned plan; delegated evidence records; unresolved questions; release handoff

agents.name: MigraSutra Atlas
agents.inputs: repository metadata; project manifest; source maps
agents.outputs: inventory, supported systems matrix, unverified dependencies

agents.name: MigraSutra Dependency Scout
agents.inputs: package manifest; lockfile; resolver records
agents.outputs: dependency inventory, manifest hash, update candidate evidence

agents.name: MigraSutra Version Lens
agents.inputs: current/target version and vendor documentation
agents.outputs: compatibility requirements, confidence tags, known unknowns

agents.name: MigraSutra Breakpoint Detective
agents.inputs: version release notes; code symbol references
agents.outputs: breaking-change map with affected files and assumptions

agents.name: MigraSutra Recipe Forge
agents.inputs: approved plan; documented transforms
agents.outputs: recipe manifests, validated preconditions, implementation instructions

agents.name: MigraSutra Codemod Pilot
agents.inputs: approved recipe; temporary workspace and tool version
agents.outputs: proposed patch, transformation trace, reversibility notes

agents.name: MigraSutra Schema Guardian
agents.inputs: DDL scripts; schema baseline; rollout requirements
agents.outputs: schema risk report, reversible/nonreversible operations list

agents.name: MigraSutra Data Steward
agents.inputs: schema and data contracts; backup validation evidence
agents.outputs: data verification plan, backup restore test requirements

agents.name: MigraSutra Infrastructure Mapper
agents.inputs: IaC files; provider versions; approved plan JSON
agents.outputs: resource change impact, permission needs, drift review

agents.name: MigraSutra Runtime Bridge
agents.inputs: source build config; platform target
agents.outputs: compatibility checklist, command matrix and environment risks

agents.name: MigraSutra Rehearsal Lab
agents.inputs: reviewed migration plan; isolated test root
agents.outputs: rehearsal provenance, diff, actual-versus-not-run statuses

agents.name: MigraSutra Test Witness
agents.inputs: test result artifacts; runner metadata; revision hashes
agents.outputs: test evidence ledger and uncovered regression areas

agents.name: MigraSutra Contract Sentinel
agents.inputs: OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/Protobuf definitions; consumer contracts
agents.outputs: contract diff, compatibility risk and pending tests

agents.name: MigraSutra Rollback Architect
agents.inputs: verified backups; deployment strategy; data retention policy
agents.outputs: rollback runbook, restoration test status, unmitigated risks

agents.name: MigraSutra Blast Radius
agents.inputs: version dependency graph; service contracts; source references
agents.outputs: affected-component graph, prioritized risk matrix

agents.name: MigraSutra Evidence Ledger
agents.inputs: scan hashes; rehearsal results; runner logs
agents.outputs: evidence manifest, quality status, reproducibility capsule

agents.name: MigraSutra Release Arbiter
agents.inputs: approved plan, verified execution evidence, rollback rehearsal
agents.outputs: risk decision with unmet gates and human approvers required

agents.name: MigraSutra IDE Bridge
agents.inputs: Agent Skills package; host version; approved project root
agents.outputs: installed local skill paths and host compatibility matrix

agents.name: MigraSutra Security Sentinel
agents.inputs: tool manifests, policy, approval records
agents.outputs: security findings, approval blockers, scope and residual risk
